messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty - PRODUCTION - prod-embed-queue detected HIGH 5xx spike. Incident ID PGSVC-8642. Auto-page triggered.
pagerbot: PagerDuty page fired to #incidents; responders notified.
kyle (eng-oncall): ack — I'm taking this. pinging sam for backup.
sam (sre): on-call here, standing by. any immediate customer-facing impact?
emma (support): saw 3 customers with elevated errors starting ~12:07 UTC. small but visible in dashboards.
kyle (eng-oncall): noted. quick config check: rolling deploy to inference-pool started ~11:59, could be kvcache misses. looking at worker logs.
nina (infra): checking autoscaler + queue depth — burst of short-lived pods and evictions on nodepool-a.
kyle (eng-oncall): i'll take lead. sam, can you open a bridge if this becomes multi-region? might need to pin to dedicated pool as fallback.
sam (sre): will open bridge if needed. runbook step summary for quick reference: 1) drain failed pod; 2) scale down problematic nodes; 3) fallback to model-variant v2-small.
kyle (eng-oncall): running quick checks:
```
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/embed-worker --since=15m | grep KVCache
kubectl -n infra get hpa embed-worker -o wide
```
kyle (eng-oncall): logs show repeated KVCache evict messages and an OOMKill on embed-worker-5.
nina (infra): applying scale +2 GPUs to dedicated pool and annotating nodes to keep pods on pinpool-1.
pagerbot: auto-escalate scheduled in 5m if no further updates.
kyle (eng-oncall): handing ownership to sam for remediation — sam, please follow with customer-facing updates when you have status. :handshake: 
sam (sre): taking over. starting migration to v2-small and draining embed-worker-5 now. will post status pings.
sam (sre): 12:18 UTC — migration in progress, errors down ~60% on affected queue.
emma (support): passing interim update to customers: "we're seeing reduced errors and are working on full remediation".
sam (sre): 12:25 UTC — migration complete, autoscaler stabilized, error rate back to baseline. closing incident.
kyle (eng-oncall): thanks — follow-up action: add kvcache memory guard to prod runbook and schedule a short postmortem.
sam (sre): creating incident ticket IN-8642 and assigning postmortem to infra.
incidentbot: Incident PGSVC-8642 resolved. Auto-close in 1h unless reopened."
